wiki.title: Melissa Murray (politician)
wiki.extract: Melissa Murray (born October 3, 1974) is an American politician and a Democratic member of the Rhode Island Senate representing District 24 since January 2019. She is the First Vice Chair of the Senate Committee on Finance, a member of the Senate Committee on Labor, and a member of the Permanent Joint Committee on State Lottery. She was on the Woonsocket City Council for two terms from 2013 to 2018.
